title_zh: 确认光学展台可用并约定由工作人员操作

scenario.label_zh: 确认光学展台可用并约定由工作人员操作
scenario.goal_zh: 核对修复后的光学展台状态，并约定志愿者引导访客等待、由受训工作人员操作

context_zh: 成人科学馆志愿者向展台工作人员询问当天演示的设备状态。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Yuri
sentences.text: Is the optical display operational again? Yesterday’s group couldn’t see the light pattern.

sentences.speaker: Esther
sentences.text: Yes. The technician replaced the damaged plug, and we tested the display this morning.

sentences.speaker: Yuri
sentences.text: Can I connect it when the next visitors arrive?

sentences.speaker: Esther
sentences.text: Leave that to the trained staff. I’ll run the demonstration while you explain where the visitors should stand.

sentences.speaker: Yuri
sentences.text: All right. I’ll gather them behind the marked line and wait for you.

sentences.speaker: Esther
sentences.text: Thanks. I’ll come over before the group enters.
